from openai import OpenAI
import json

client = OpenAI()

def rewrite(q: str) -> list[str]:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": f'Output JSON: {{"queries": [...]}} with {{n_queries}} rephrasings.'},
            {"role": "user", "content": q},
        ],
    )
    return json.loads(r.choices[0].message.content)["queries"]
